insert into "jairoads_next"."audit_notification_recipients" ("audit_log_id", "recipient_user_id", "notification_message", "created_at") select $1::bigint AS audit_log_id, account.id AS recipient_user_id, $2::text AS notification_message, $3::timestamp AS created_at from "public"."users" as "login" inner join "jairoads_next"."user_accounts" as "account" on "login"."dd_user_account_id" = "account"."id" left join "jairoads_next"."engineers" as "engineer" on "account"."engineer_id" = "engineer"."id" left join "jairoads_security"."account_provisioning" as "provenance" on "provenance"."user_account_id" = "account"."id" where "account"."account_type" in ($4, $5, $6, $7) and LOWER(account.email) = LOWER(login.email) and (SELECT count(*) FROM public.users AS bridge WHERE bridge.dd_user_account_id = account.id) = 1 and (("account"."account_type" = $8 and "account"."engineer_id" is null) or ("account"."engineer_id" > $9 and "engineer"."engineer_status" = $10)) and "account"."is_active" = $11 and login.password = accoun
